svg.data-weight-note: 58 lb (26.3 kg) chassis. Fan module 1.35 lb (0.61 kg). Supply 3.6 lb (1.63 kg), the row for the 3200 W and the 3000 W AC/HVDC supplies.
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 120 V or 200 to 240 V at 16 A max, 50/60 Hz (3200 W AC/HVDC)
svg.data-power-input-hvdc: 240 VDC at 14.5 max (3200 W AC/HVDC and DC/HVDC)
svg.data-power-supply-options: 3200W AC/HVDC or 3200W DC/HVDC (two); the weights row also names a 3000W AC/HVDC
svg.data-altitude: 0 to 10,000 ft (3,048 m) operating; 6,562 ft (2000 m) for China
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: guide: "400-Gigabit QSFP-DD ports (64)". Table 1, 3200 W supplies, 40 C ambient limit: 12 W per port with 16 MACsec ports enabled; 20 W on 8 or 16 odd ports and 12 W on the rest with 8 or 0 MACsec ports
svg.data-management-ports: front figure: one RJ-45 and one SFP management port, and a console port

g.data-input-voltage: DC range 100-120 VDC, 16 A max, 50/60 Hz (as printed); HVDC range 240 VDC, 14.5 max; input voltage row -40 to -72 VDC; 47 to 63 Hz
